author: jessica
_note: TESTCASE 01, THE TWO-BEAT CUT. Jessica's page writes four beats: find the load, take it to the
centre and find the other half gone, recover what took it, come back and finish the job.
THIS RECIPE IS BEATS ONE AND FOUR. The middle two need a driver that can stage an absence and a
recovery, and no shipped script does that, so they are not silently dropped -- they are absent.
It will therefore read as a carry rather than as a delve, which is her own stated failure
condition 1. That is the honest cost of the first one working end to end.
Her rule the prose is written under: NAME THE HALF THE PLAYER IS CARRYING, NEVER THE HALF THAT
IS MISSING. No line below describes the fixture, the mount, the machine or the room, because
what is actually at a RECenterLocRef is untested geometry and her failure condition 2.

place._theme: Deliberately empty. The testcase is themeless so the skeleton is what is under test.

prose.briefing: A load was signed out for the <Place> and never signed in. Nobody has been out to look for it. Find where it stopped.
